summary: Independent bounded calculations reproduce both degree17 ordinary terminal contradictions and the A3 inverse/positivity arithmetic. A concrete triangle-free weighted graph demonstrates that H27 cannot be weakened to28 in the positivity argument. The new external-source caveat is therefore material and appropriately retained. No new local proof defect was found; frozen hashes match and earlier resolved revisions remain intact.

findings.statement: Order68, triangle-freeness and minimum degree25 do not force occupied A3 fibres if the independence cap is relaxed from27 to28. The explicit weighted A3 example below has three empty fibres.
findings.disposition: This confirms the necessity of the imported H27 value. The new manuscript paragraph and superseding source addendum disclose the unreconstructed historical-run provenance; local degree-case checks do not fill that gap. No counterexample to H27 itself is claimed.

checks.scope: Degree17 P10 incidence constants and scalar margin
checks.method: Read D17-P10-ordinary-closure.md, including the multiplicity-aware pair-pool proof; independently enumerated literal P10 trace intersections and all bounded nonnegative integer O,H,P,E satisfying its necessary scalar premises.
checks.observation: Every singleton meets5 blocks, every pair8, and triples meet9 or10. Every pair is avoided by a block. Under O+H+P+E=51, O+H<=27, P<=18 and H+2P+3E<=60, the exact maximum of 5H+8P+10E is234, attained in the relaxation at (O,H,P,E)=(21,6,18,6). The ten actual cones require240. This verifies the strict six-unit contradiction; it does not replay the twelve nonempty-internal certificates.

checks.scope: P9 arbitrary-support terminal reduction and capacity13
checks.method: For all ten possible omitted P10 blocks, independently enumerated three-transversals and pair avoidance. For each I8 type, enumerated allowed core traces of size<=2 or pure triples and every disjoint trace pair jointly hitting the root link.
checks.observation: Every P9 deletion has exactly its nine retained blocks, the omitted block and its complement as its eleven three-transversals. No pair covers it. For P8-i1, P8-i2 and Q8 the trace-pair checks found respectively132,143,132 pairs, all containing a pure-Y transversal. Therefore, conditional on the preceding mixed-three/core-four exclusions, removing at most9+2+2=13 residual members leaves an intersecting family and gives40<51. Arbitrary exterior completions are counted by triple codegree, not assigned distinct-support labels or discarded.

checks.scope: A3 cyclic inverse, positivity order and strict Jin thresholds
checks.method: Expanded all eight coefficient rows of b_i+b_(i+3)+b_(i+5) using standard-library integer arithmetic; independently checked the mass identities and both relevant strict threshold products.
checks.observation: Each row counts every a_j once and a_i twice, giving 68+a_i. With b_i<=27, sum e_i=12 and a_i=13-e_i-e_(i+3)-e_(i+5)>=1 before invoking any occupied-fibre lower bound. Only then b_i>=25 gives sum r_i=4 and a_i=7+r_i+r_(i+3)+r_(i+5). Jin thresholds are275>272 for cap15 and480>476 for degree16. No equality was rounded into a strict application.

checks.scope: Robustness boundary under a weaker intersecting-family input
checks.method: Read the new H27 scope addendum and revised manuscript paragraph; constructed a complete weighted A3 graph and exhaustively checked all256 image supports for its independence number.
checks.observation: Fibre masses (0,15,13,0,12,0,15,13) give order68, adjacent masses (12,27,28,28,28,28,28,25), triangle-freeness, minimum actual degree25 and independence number28. Fibres0,3,5 are empty. This concretely falsifies a positivity claim with cap28, consistent with the symbolic lower bound136-5h becoming-4. It is a graph counterexample to that weakened inference, not a sunflower-family counterexample. The manuscript retains H27 as an external theorem and expressly disclaims authenticated source-to-historical-run reconstruction.
